articles.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
articles.description: Shopify is expanding WebMCP support to checkout, allowing browser-based AI agents to update order details and complete purchases with a buyer’s authorization.

articles.title: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
articles.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Monday introduced a toolkit of software and hardware products that add independent security layers around AI agents to ensure they stay within their test environments even if they attempt to break out.

articles.title: Google is killing off Gemini’s Gems in favor of ‘skills’
articles.description: As all-in-one AI agents like Meta's Muse and Instinct take off, Google is opting to end a feature that built task-specific agents.

articles.title: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
articles.description: Meta says it will focus on bringing its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more to businesses and developers.

articles.title: How we will do better for Australia
articles.description: OpenAI apologises for incidents involving Australian government websites and outlines stronger safeguards and support to strengthen Australia’s cyber defences.

articles.title: The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
articles.description: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.

articles.title: Basis completes a tax workbook 2x faster with GPT-6 Astra
articles.description: GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol, and its stronger understanding of user intent gives Basis more confidence in real-world use.
